import json,urllib.request,urllib.error
TOK=open("/root/nocodb-token.txt").read().strip()
def nc(m,p,d=None):
    b=json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False).encode() if d is not None else None
    r=urllib.request.Request("http://localhost:8080"+p,data=b,method=m,
      headers={"Content-Type":"application/json","xc-token":TOK})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=90) as x:
            t=x.read().decode(); return x.status,(json.loads(t) if t else {})
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: return e.code,{"err":e.read().decode()[:200]}
MODES=["фрахт","фрахт+ТЕО","фрахт+ТЕО+МО","авіа","авіа+ТЕО","авіа+ТЕО+МО",
       "фрахт+ТЕО+залізниця","ТЕО+авто","ТЕО+залізниця","авто"]
LOADS=["FCL","LCL","FTL","LTL"]
st,m=nc("GET","/api/v2/meta/tables/m58xsjo6at01ohl")
have={c["title"] for c in m["columns"]}
for title,cname,opts in (("Вид перевезення","vyd_perevezennya",MODES),("FCL/LCL","fcl_lcl",LOADS)):
    if title in have: print("ВЖЕ Є:",title); continue
    s,j=nc("POST","/api/v2/meta/tables/m58xsjo6at01ohl/columns",
      {"title":title,"column_name":cname,"uidt":"SingleSelect",
       "colOptions":{"options":[{"title":o,"order":i+1} for i,o in enumerate(opts)]}})
    print("СТВОРЕНО",title,s,str(j)[:60])
st,m=nc("GET","/api/v2/meta/tables/m58xsjo6at01ohl")
for c in m["columns"]:
    if c["title"] in ("Вид перевезення","FCL/LCL"):
        print("%s: %s"%(c["title"],[o["title"] for o in (c.get("colOptions") or {}).get("options",[])]))
print("колонок у таблиці:",len(m["columns"]))
EOF
